{{Top|leg}}
A '''Great House''' was a type of aristocratic family. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Great Houses [[House Juoni]], [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] and [[House Vahali/Legends|House Vahali]] gained influence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] and became collectively known as the [[Triad (Great Houses)|Triad]].
